title: A bifunctional antibody conjugate marks the location of DNA binding proteins on deproteinized DNA fibers
authors: Durga Pokharel; Althaf Shaik; Himabindu Gali; Chen Ling; Marina A. Bellani; Michael M Seidman
one_liner_zh: 该文开发抗体偶联物标记DNA结合蛋白在DNA纤维上的位置，虽涉及蛋白-DNA互作但无AI/物理模拟方法，且非TF-DNA体系，仅边缘相关。
abstract: Immunofluorescent foci of DNA Damage Response (DDR) proteins serve as surrogates for DNA damage and are frequently interpreted as denoting specific lesions. For example, Double Strand Breaks (DSBs) are potent inducers of the DDR, whose best-known factor is the phosphorylated histone variant H2AX (γ-H2AX). The association with DSBs is so well established that the reverse interpretation that γ-H2AX invariably implies DSBs is routine. However, this conclusion is inferential and has been challenged. The resolution of this question has been hampered by the lack of methods for distinguishing the location of DDR proteins relative to DSBs caused by sequence indifferent agents. Here, we describe an approach for marking the location of DDR factors in relation to DSBs on DNA fibers. We synthesized a two-arm “Y” conjugate containing biotin and trimethylpsoralen (TMP) coupled to a secondary antibody. After exposure to a DNA breaker, permeabilized mammalian cells were incubated with a primary antibody against the DDR factor followed by binding of the secondary antibody in the conjugate to the primary antibody. Exposure to longwave UV light covalently linked the psoralen to the DNA. DNA fibers were spread, and the immunofluorescence of the biotin tag denoted the location of the target protein. abstract_zh: DNA损伤应答（DDR）蛋白的免疫荧光灶点作为DNA损伤的替代标志物，常被解读为特定损伤类型的指示。例如，双链断裂（DSBs）是DDR的强效诱导因素，其最著名的因子是磷酸化组蛋白变体H2AX（γ-H2AX）。γ-H2AX与DSBs的关联已如此确凿，以至于反向解读——即γ-H2AX必然意味着DSBs——成为常规做法。然而，这一结论属于推断性质，并已受到质疑。由于缺乏区分DDR蛋白位置与由序列无关试剂所致DSBs相对关系的方法，该问题的解决一直受阻。在此，我们描述了一种在DNA纤维上标记DDR因子相对于DSBs位置的方法。我们合成了一种含有生物素和三甲基补骨脂素（TMP）的双臂“Y”形偶联物，并偶联至二抗。在暴露于DNA断裂剂后，透化处理的哺乳动物细胞与针对DDR因子的一抗孵育，随后偶联物中的二抗结合至一抗。长波紫外线照射将补骨脂素共价连接至DNA。随后铺展DNA纤维，生物素标签的免疫荧光指示目标蛋白的位置。摘要图 图形摘要
